description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes authorization review API objects, including SubjectAccessReview, SelfSubjectAccessReview, and LocalSubjectAccessReview, along with helper functions for validating resource attributes and selectors.

methods.name: ValidateSubjectAccessReviewSpec
methods.description: Validates a SubjectAccessReviewSpec object, ensuring proper attribute combinations and presence of user or group.

methods.name: ValidateSelfSubjectAccessReviewSpec
methods.description: Validates a SelfSubjectAccessReviewSpec object, similar to the above but for self reviews.

methods.name: ValidateSubjectAccessReview
methods.description: Validates a SubjectAccessReview object, including its spec and metadata.

methods.name: ValidateSelfSubjectAccessReview
methods.description: Validates a SelfSubjectAccessReview object, including its spec and metadata.

methods.name: ValidateLocalSubjectAccessReview
methods.description: Validates a LocalSubjectAccessReview object, including namespace consistency and attribute restrictions.

methods.name: validateResourceAttributes
methods.description: Helper function to validate resource attributes, including selectors.

methods.name: validateFieldSelectorAttributes
methods.description: Validates field selector attributes, ensuring correct requirements and raw selectors.

methods.name: validateLabelSelectorAttributes
methods.description: Validates label selector attributes, ensuring correct requirements and raw selectors.
